summary: iTonic Holdings filed a Form 6-K on August 27, 2026, reporting the immediate resignation of CFO Zhixin Li and the appointment of Simin Tan as her successor. No disagreement or claims were stated. Ms. Tan previously worked at MarcumAsia, PwC, and other firms. The company entered employment and indemnification agreements, standard for the role. This routine CFO transition, without disclosed discord, is a typical management change. No deal terms or special-situation elements are present. Watch for any subsequent announcements on strategy or financial reporting under new leadership.
